servinfo.title: Fuel Injector Cleaning Description
servinfo.ptxt: The tip of the fuel injector is exposed to the combustion chamber under high temperature and high pressure, and gradually affected by carbon deposits.
Depending on the country or region where the vehicle is used (i.e. depending on the fuel and/or driving conditions), however, periodical injector inspection is necessary.
For the country and region, refer to “Fuel injection” in Maintenance Schedule under Normal Driving Conditions (Except for Europe) .
In the market applicable to the injector maintenance, perform the injector carbon deposit inspection every 30,000 km (18,000 miles) or 36 months, whichever comes first.
